dedupe_keys.name: bearing vibration dataset of a hydropower project

description: Bearing Vibration Dataset of a Hydropower Project is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Yasir Saleem Afridi. Twelve months of bearing vibration data acquired from the SCADA system installed at a Hydro Power Project Operating in Pakistan, having a total generation capacity of 969 MW. The number of units installed are four, each having a generation capacity of 242.25 MW. Coverage: national (PK); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 3832579 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
